label: Tracking, realism and moral access
resolution: Causal tracking is one proposed explanation of reliability, not a synonym for every truth–belief correlation. Enoch’s third factor uses causal influence on belief and a noncausal normative link; whether it adequately explains reliability is open. Street’s stance-independence and the project’s appraiser-independence are distinct: her classification of Railton’s individual welfare does not silently revise our objective-interest statement or transfer to impartial moral rightness. Knowledge, truth-aptness, an explanatory correlation, adaptive behavioral success and direct justification are not interchanged. Catholic q94 gives a teleological practical-reason account and fallibility, not in this range a proof of evolution-proof access or an explicit divine design guarantee.
